integrity: General theorem has an algebraic proof; finite code checks labeled graphs through six vertices and exact coalitions for seven representatives. No exhaustive verification beyond those limits.
scientific_limitations: Exact only for finite simple nonempty regular edge-approval graphs with even vertex count, half-size committees and grand-only subsidy. Prior published K4 nonexistence instance is credited. The balanced-cut maximum is not generally an unrestricted max cut. No independent validation or priority certification.
title: Maximum bisection exactly measures coalition-stability subsidies in regular-edge approval elections
